_schema_note: An issue is an ORDERED SELECTION WITH AN ARGUMENT. Neither the registry nor the venue records can hold that: they carry membership, not sequence, and no place for why a piece sits where it sits. This record is the bibliographic card for an issue — modelled on the heteronym identity cards, canonical, with the JSONL surface projected from it.

rationale: The title is the journal's own charter subtitle. Founded on VISIBLE CORRECTION rather than error prevention, so the issue leads with the dataset and the instruments that make error visible, and ends on the method for studying systems that will not open.

_rebuilt.why: THE INAUGURAL ISSUE OF A JOURNAL OF MACHINE-MEDIATED THEOLOGICAL RECEPTION CARRIED NOTHING ON REVELATION. Eight items, all capture registry and instruments, on a venue edited by an apostle, hosted at revelationfirst.com, whose subject is retrieval-layer theological reception. Seven Revelation-First deposits were ALREADY ASSIGNED TO MMRS in the registry and none was in its own first issue.
